title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 13
paragraphs: He took possession of the kingdom, and the oracle at Delphi confirmed his rule. For when the Lydians, angry over the death of Candaules, had risen in arms, an agreement was reached between Gyges's supporters and the rest of the Lydians: that if the oracle answered that he was to be king of the Lydians, he should be king, and if not, he should hand the power back to the descendants of Heracles. The oracle gave its answer, and Gyges became king. But the Pythian prophetess added this: that vengeance for the Heraclids would fall upon the fifth descendant of Gyges. Of this oracle the Lydians and their kings took no account — until it was in fact fulfilled.
